Title: Service Bus Standard Base Unit name change

Body.Content:
On June 1, 2019, the unit of measure for the Azure Service Bus Standard Base Unit Germany resource GUID (also known as meter ID) will change. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names.

See the following table for details.

Resource GUID (meter ID)

Service name

Service type

Resource name

Region name

Old direct unit of measure

New direct unit of measure

Old EA unit of measure

New EA unit of measure
